summary: Running a high-stress student storage operation pushed entrepreneur Nick Huber to his absolute breaking point during a brutal delivery season filled with severe exhaustion and non-stop operational disasters. The **culmination of equipment damage, abandoned delivery trucks, and relentless customer complaints** triggered a severe panic attack while he was managing the chaos entirely alone. Overwhelmed by physical fatigue and psychological pressure, he reached out to his support network for guidance and ultimately received the **tough-love encouragement needed to push through the crisis**. This harrowing experience highlights how **difficult business hurdles test an entrepreneur's mental resilience**, teaching them how to navigate complex decision-making and recognize when to persevere through extreme adversity.
